methods.description: List workspace files matching a query, in path order. The Host filters and never ranks, so a caller sorts the page itself. matchOn picks the file name or the relative path; matching is case-insensitive, and matchSpans are half-open [start, end] positions in that field (empty for glob). Files ignored by Git are left out unless respectGitignore is false, and gitignoreApplied is false when the Host could not apply it. Hidden files and noise directories (node_modules, dist, .venv and similar) need includeHidden and includeNoiseDirs; .git and symbolic links are never listed. Listings are cached and refreshed on disk changes, so a new file can take a moment to appear. listingTruncated says the listing stopped early, at its size limit or time limit. timedOut says this call reached its time limit: the page is partial and nextCursor continues from where it stopped. One query runs at a time per plugin: a call made during another answers ok false with error busy at once, and the caller retries when it wants to.

Case-insensitive substring match over workspace files. A query with a path separator matches the relative path, any other query the file name only. Exact matches come first and the rest are in walk order, with no other ranking. Noise directories, hidden files and binary-like extensions are skipped, and at most maxResults paths are returned.
